data.one_liner: Check if another app is installed, enabled, launch it, and list installed apps on Android/iOS.
data.what_it_does: This plugin lets you query whether a specific app is installed or enabled, launch it via a URI scheme, and retrieve a list of installed apps on Android. It handles platform‑specific permissions and URL scheme declarations.
use_when: Need to verify another app is available before performing an action
Want to launch an external app from your Flutter app
Need to display a list of installed apps on Android
avoid_when: You only need to open a URL in a webview or external browser
You need a comprehensive app store browsing feature
strengths: Cross‑platform support for Android and iOS
Simple API with clear method names
Handles required permissions and URL scheme setup
Background thread execution for getInstalledApps() to avoid UI blocking
weaknesses: Requires manual permission and Info.plist configuration
No built‑in UI components for displaying apps
data.setup_notes: Add QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission and <queries> block in AndroidManifest.xml for getInstalledApps(); add LSApplicationQueriesSchemes array in Info.plist for iOS URL schemes.
